name: start-voice-guide
description: Builds a Writing Voice Guide from 10 to 20 pieces you wrote and sent yourself, with how you open, ask and sign off quoted from your own text, the words you use and never use, an AI-tell checklist and one real message shown before and after. Use for "run start-voice-guide", "make it sound like me", "write like me", "my drafts sound like AI", "build my voice guide", "check this for AI tells", "why does this sound so generic", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
